message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, sorted roughly by passenger traffic (largest to smaller but still significant):

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and Latin America; one of the busiest airports on the West Coast. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the oldest major hubs; major hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Major hub for American Airlines; largest airport in Texas. |
| Denver International Airport | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport in the Rocky Mountain region; major hub for United Airlines. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City, NY | JFK | Major hub for international flights; primary hub for many carriers including Delta and JetBlue. |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Major hub for United Airlines; key gateway to Asia and the Pacific Rim. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle, WA | SEA | Major hub for Alaska Airlines; growing hub for other carriers like Delta. |
| Miami International Airport | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for international flights to Latin America and the Caribbean; primary hub for American Airlines. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports in the U.S. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; high volume of domestic flights. |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando, FL | ORL | Major hub for leisure travel; primary hub for carriers such as Southwest and Spirit. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | Newark, NJ | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; serves the New York metropolitan area. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport | Detroit, MI | DTW | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; one of the largest airports in the Midwest. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport | Dulles, VA | IAD | Major hub for United Airlines; serves the Washington, D.C. metro area. |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger numbers and flight operations, and they serve as major hubs for several airlines. If you need more detailed statistics or additional airports, let me know!
